effective_period.quote: The calendar year refers to the plan year, which is defined as January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2026.

scope.geography: Nationwide (United States) plus international; rates vary by one of five rating regions determined by home ZIP code. Includes North Carolina, but the brochure pages that list regions by state (end of brochure) could not be read.

scope.network: Delta Dental PPO(TM) and Delta Dental Legion(TM) networks; out-of-network care allowed and paid on an out-of-network plan allowance

facts.value: out-of-network plan allowance; member pays coinsurance plus any billed amount over the allowance (balance billing); lower annual maximum
facts.basis: how non-network dentists are paid
facts.quote: When you use an out-of-network dentist, you are responsible for the difference between the plan allowance and our payment plus the difference up to the submitted/approved charges.
facts.section: Section 3 How You Obtain Care — Plan allowance
facts.notes: Full paragraph (p. 13): "The plan allowance is the amount we allow for a specific procedure. When you use an in-network Delta Dental Federal Employees Dental Program provider, your out-of-pocket cost is limited to the difference between the plan allowance and our payment. When you use an out-of-network dentist, you are responsible for the difference between the plan allowance and our payment plus the difference up to the submitted/approved charges." Also pp. 12-13 (Out-of-network): "You may obtain care from any licensed dentist. If the dentist is not part of our network, benefits will be considered out-of-network. When you see a dentist who is outside of Delta Dental's participating network for the Federal Employees Dental Program, you will have a lower annual maximum benefit and we pay for services based on an out-of-network plan allowance. You are responsible for any difference between the plan payment and the amount submitted/approved." The dollar basis of the out-of-network allowance (fee schedule vs percentile) is not stated in readable pages; Section 9 Definitions unreadable.

facts.value: in-network: no charges above network allowance; out-of-network: coinsurance plus billed amount over plan allowance
facts.basis: Section 4 restatement
facts.quote: you will be responsible for your co-insurance percentage plus the billed amount over plan allowance.
facts.section: Section 4 — Out-of-Network Services
facts.notes: In-Network Services (p. 16): "You pay the coinsurance percentage of our network allowance for covered services. You are not responsible for charges above that allowance." Out-of-Network Services (p. 16): "If the dentist you use is not part of our network, benefits will be considered out-of-network. Because these providers are not part of our network, we pay for services rendered by an out-of-network provider based on an out-of-network plan allowance; you will be responsible for your co-insurance percentage plus the billed amount over plan allowance."
